shrooming.boundary: Published-state inspection, sandbox reading, greenhouse question probing, and explicit formal greenhouse round advancement remain executable. muther.boundary: Published mining-state audit and repository corpus mining are executable. MINE_REPO collects repository candidates before bounded selection, fingerprints superficially normalized snippets, suppresses duplicate copies, records occurrence/provenance metadata and round-robins across path-derived source families to reduce first-file bias. This is deterministic structural diversity handling, not semantic clustering, source-quality scoring, novelty proof or truth judgment. Query-scoped Google Drive mining is executed by the authorized external connector runtime and handed back as redacted evidence. MINE_INTERNAL remains limited to explicit authorized query-scoped connector sources; it does not grant exhaustive private-environment crawling or cross-source enumeration. FALSIFY remains repository-scoped and absence is never upgraded to truth.

droplet.boundary: Published evidence audit and explicit-URL verification are executable. Search-engine discovery is executed by the external web connector runtime. VERIFY v1.1 computes SUPPORTED, REFUTED or INDETERMINATE over an explicit evidence bundle while suppressing exact replay amplification, counting caller-supplied source families as audit metadata, forcing INDETERMINATE on conflicting authoritative directions, and flagging contradictory use of one evidence fingerprint. It does not search the web by itself, prove source independence, score methodological quality, or treat absence of refutation as global truth.

gut.boundary: GUT v0.2.19 is a deterministic heuristic metabolic router. It preserves nutrient atoms, routes and provenance while applying carry-rendering containment including inherited-substrate subtraction, route-metadata stripping, tagged payload/tail suppression, adjacent and delimited segment collapse, shared-body summary diversity, exact non-adjacent full-width-colon clause compaction, short-token run collapse, volatile ref/clause lineage normalization, repeated lineage-signature collapse and active-loop same-route cross-segment near-echo suppression. The latest 10-round active-loop carry echo audit is PASS with zero detected exact, nested, recursive-wrapper or short-token issues under the current checks. These are bounded deterministic normalization rules, not semantic deletion, semantic novelty detection, source-truth judgment, or proof that all metabolic echo is solved.

vajra.boundary: VAJRA v0.3.4 retains the v0.3.1 proposition-aware core and layers the verified receipt uncertainty/relation guard through v0.3.4. It keeps lexically detected proposition types and bounded syntactic clause decomposition for explicit causal forms. OPEN branch contracts carry targetRef plus clauseRef and require matching lens, preferred organ, execution status, provenance, substantive returned material and relation-to-target before structural closure. Cross-clause receipts are rejected; replay identity canonicalizes provenance and returned material; conflicting qualifying support/refute receipts remain CONTESTED; explicit uncertainty and noncommittal relations remain unresolved; and a single receipt containing both support and refute polarity is rejected as MIXED_RELATION rather than falsely closing. These remain deterministic lexical/structural heuristics, not semantic adequacy judgment, source-quality judgment, factual truth, or proof that the original proposition is settled.
